dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: If you make a lantern like this and release it... Will the wish really come true...?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Oh! You're in Liyue too? Happy Lantern Rite...

choices.text: I've released my Xiao Lantern, too.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Wow... your lantern's so far up there! Huh, I wonder how high it could go...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Oh, right, there's a formula for that! I just have to plug in the numbers. Now where's my scratch paper...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Yeah, my advisor sent me. She said participating in folk festivals might help spark some inspiration for my research...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: But... I work on Star Charts. I'm still not sure what that has to do with holidays like this...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: But she had already bought me a ticket and escorted me onto the boat before I even had a chance to ask...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: As soon as I got off the boat, a lady stopped and offered me a free Xiao Lantern frame. She said releasing one would bring good luck for the entire year.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: I'm... not sure I need a whole year of luck. But, a little bit when it's time to submit my thesis wouldn't hurt...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: So, I followed her instructions and made one...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Luck will certainly find you, Layla.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Thanks. I should release the lantern now, right? Oh! I need to write my wish on it first...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Layla release a Xiao Lantern together...
